notes: §1985:XIV.3.3.4 GR3: ENABLE INPUT TERMINAL activates "the logical paths between the source (as defined by the content of the data item referenced by data-name-7 (SYMBOLIC SOURCE)) and all of its associated queues and sub-queues". SetPath's InputTerminal arm finds the source and SetSourcePaths enables it and its path to every queue level, which PathOpen/Deliver honour. Witness: T1 disabled, ENABLE INPUT TERMINAL 00 delivers to QA and QB, again 15; pb5286_enable_terminal_reopens_queue_path matches. Probes at 85 (gr3s, gr7): unknown and blank SYMBOLIC SOURCE 21; DISABLE then ENABLE T1 moves a held message into Q1/S1 (count 0 -> 1), again 15; a wrong KEY 40.

next.reason: 1985: "When the INPUT phrase with the optional word TERMINAL is specified, the logical paths between the source ... are activated."; 2023: "No candidate covers the ENABLE statement or the communication module; 2023 lacks the communication feature.". The communication module (ENABLE INPUT TERMINAL, SYMBOLIC SOURCE, queues) is not in 2023. No candidate covers activating logical paths, so the requirement is dropped.
